item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. Your day already has a wind-down built in: relaxation in the evening, then a set bedtime. That structure is your advantage, so protect it. Sleep isn't earned by pushing through. It's set up by what you do in the last hour. Screens off, lights low, and no problem-solving in bed. If a thought shows up, write it down and leave it there. Tonight, start your wind-down on time and put the phone in another room.
